info.name: Transaction Aggregation API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Transaction Aggregation API microservices.

**Services:**
- Accounts Service (port 8081)
- Customer Service (port 8082)
- Credit Cards Service (port 8083)
- Loans Service (port 8084)
- API Gateway (port 8071)
- Eureka Server (port 8070)

Use the `transaction-aggregation-api.local` environment for local development.

item.name: API Gateway

request.description:
Aggregated composite endpoint that fetches a full customer summary including:
- Customer profile details
- All account transactions within the date range
- All credit card transactions within the date range
- All loan transactions within the date range

This endpoint is served by the API Gateway and internally calls the Customer, Accounts, Credit Cards, and Loans microservices.

**Date format:** YYYY-MM-DD

response.name: 200 OK - Customer Summary
